title: "Role Card: The Bridge (Apex)"
---

**Your side:** Apex Labs
**Your role:** The Bridge

---

You were genuinely excited about this acquisition. You've been telling your Apex colleagues for weeks to give Meridian a fair chance — that the client relationships and the infrastructure are real assets, and that some structure might actually help the team scale. A few of them think you've already gone corporate.

In this meeting, you'll try to translate between the two sides and find proposals that both can live with. You really want this all to work out and you are committed to trying to figure out solutions.
